evidence.what: dense queue of cars and buses filling right carriageway
pedestrians on central median platform and overpass, none on roadway
left carriageway with free-flowing traffic and no stopped vehicles

verdict.summary: No incident; heavy congestion on one carriageway, light traffic on the other.
verdict.details: Aerial top-down view of divided multi-lane highway with central bus rapid transit median and pedestrian overpass. Right carriageway shows dense stop-and-go congestion with cars, vans and buses. Left carriageway flows freely. Pedestrians visible only on median platform and overpass, not on road. No crash, responders, or blockage visible.
